hypothesis: Theory-defined function bundles explain valuation multiples better than an unweighted count of functions.

outcomes.mean_log_market_cap_usd: Mean daily log market capitalization over the common frozen H2 window.
outcomes.mean_log_market_cap_to_daily_fees: Mean daily log of market capitalization divided by lagged daily fees, a fee multiple; chain-scope and application-scope fees are pooled and this scope mix is a declared limit.

withheld_outcomes.market_cap_to_activity: Free activity data covers only four of the six assets; withheld rather than estimated on a subset chosen after the fact.

nested_pair.reason: Holder capture is the bundle the value-accrual literature singles out, so it is the one pre-declared theory addition to the count model.

selection_rule: Every model is listed before estimation; no bundle weights or model choices are selected from outcomes. Models whose predictor has no cross-asset variation are reported as unestimable, not dropped silently.
interpretation: Six assets support description and sign checks only. Leave-one-out prediction error and exact 720-permutation rank tests are exploratory; no model comparison here is confirmatory.
